While memory is expected to easily become the single largest item in the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the same may not be true for the iPhone Duo. Here's what we know so far.

Apple signs three-year exclusive deal with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital claimed today on Weibo that Apple has signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement with Samsung Display for foldable panels.

The leaker said Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and its successor models," with each panel costing about $250.

The leaker also noted that the panel is "undoubtedly one of the most expensive core components of the device."

While a reliable figure for the expected bill of materials of the iPhone Duo has not yet been released, Apple has disclosed material information for the device based on the cost of the display, camera, processor, memory and other components, as well as the proportion of recycled materials.
